title: Research: a fifth joint exchange on X4 does not improve κ (complete census)
body:
## Summary

This package runs a complete census of a fifth joint read-set exchange on the selected X4 word, with X4's recipe and the eight PR741 B frames held fixed. No candidate improves or ties X4's κ of `0.001661634653669567`. No new supplier or κ is claimed.

- 10144 candidates (3180 subset combinations after X4, with frame policies).
- 1536 legal, in 12 distinct profiles. The best scores `0.001661526629932125`.
- Rejections: 5640 target cap, 2968 duplicate frame, 0 B-segment exactness.
- Every legal candidate replays through the pinned `build_jx.build`: 1536 accepted, 0 profile mismatches.
- 11 positive controls and 8 negative controls pass, including a rebuild of X4's own four exchanges.

All inputs are read from commit `f567884a` and pinned by SHA-256. Nothing upstream is modified.

## Reproduce

```
bash research/x4-fifth-joint-exchange-seed32/reproduce.sh
```

Attribution and AI-assistance disclosure are in `research/x4-fifth-joint-exchange-seed32/NOTICE.md`.
